source: English translation extracted and cleaned from the user-supplied bilingual Hizbul-Azam PDF

items.text: 1. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Muhammad and on the family of our Noble Master, Nabi
Muhammad just as You bestowed mercy on Ibraahim and his family
Verily You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious. O Allah, pour Your blessings on our Noble Master, Muhammad and on the family of our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad just as
You blessed Ibraahim and his family
Verily You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious
2. O Allah, be kind to our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad and the family of our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad just as You were kind to Ibraahim and his family

Verily You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious. O Allah, be compassionate towards our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad and the family of our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad just as You showed compassion towards Ibraahim and his family. Verily You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious

O Allah, grant peace to our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad and the family of our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad just as You granted peace to Ibraahim and his family. Verily You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious
) ( 3. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi
Muhammad , (the unlettered Prophet),
3. Abu Dawood Page 141 on his wives, the spiritual mothers of the Muslims, his children and
( ) his household just as You bestowed mercy on Ibraahim and his family

Bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad the unlettered prophet, his wives, his household and children just as You blessed Ibraahim and his family amongst all the inhabitants of the world. Verily You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious
4. O Allah, grant him (Nabi Muhammad ) a place of nearness to You in Your Court on the Day of Judgement

5. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy, blessings and grace on the leader of all the Messengers, leader of the pious, the last of all prophets, our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad , Your servant and messenger, a guide towards good and a leader in virtue; The Messenger of mercy. O Allah, raise him to that praiseworthy position where he will be envied by the first and the last of the entire mankind
6. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Muhammad and his family with Your special blessings, mercy and grace just as You blessed Ibraahim and his family
Verily, You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious
7. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Muhammad and raise him to the position of Waseelah and to the highest position
7. Al Qawlul Badee Page 106 in Jannah. O Allah, grant Your chosen ones his love and (grant) to those near to You, his friendship and manifest his name on the lips of the highest ranking personalities
May peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him
8. Oh Allah, the being who levelled the earth, creator of the high skies. Oh Master of the hearts which have been moulded on their natural good or bad. Grant your honourable mercies

Your fruitful blessing and most lavish kindness to Muhammad may the peace and blessings of Allah Ta’ala be upon him, your servant and messenger; the one who has (perfected) and sealed nubuwwat which continued before him, the opener of (avenues of spiritual perfection) which has been closed, the one who has announced true deen with honesty, the conqueror of the armies of falsehood. As he was entrusted with this responsibility, he got ready to obey you as per your command, enthusiastic to acquire

You pleasure without hesitating and without the least dullness in resolve, the one who safeguarded your revelations. And fully observed the promises made to you, one who worked (tirelessly) to execute your commandments until he kindled the light for the one seeking light
The favours of Allah Ta’ala convey the seekers of light to the enlightened path. Through him the hearts

Were enabled to be guided after being submerged in trials and sins and through him Allah Ta’ala exposed the clear signs. And the radiant light of Islam and its bright practices. So he is the trusted one on whom you have full confidence and the custodian of Your treasure of treasure of knowledge and Your witness on the day of

Judgement, he is the one who you have blessed with nubuwwat out of Your sheer grace, the one who, You, out of your mercy has charged to be Your true messenger. Oh Allah Ta’ala widen for his spacious residence in your eternal paradise and by Your grace reward him with multiplied virtues i.e. Your special abundant reward and Your immense treasure of gifts which will prove to be a source of happiness for him and not a source of displeasing him. Oh Allah Ta’ala, raise his palace above
The buildings of all that build and honour his presence in Your court and afford him the best hospitality. And perfect for him his light. And honour him to rise in the plains of Hashr,

With his testimony, earning Your approval, his speech conforming to Your pleasure, his word being just, his line of action being the decisive factor between right and wrong, his argument being triumphant and strong
May the peace and blessings of Allah Ta’ala be upon him
9. O Allah, make us submissive and obedient to Your commands and make us sincere friends and pleasant companions. O Allah convey our salaam to Rasulullah and favour us with a salaam from him

10. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad , the Prophet, as many times as those among Your creatures have uttered their greetings to him and bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad , the Prophet, in proportion to the obligation we are under to send greetings upon him; and bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad , the Nabi, as You have commanded us to offer greetings to him

11. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad to the extent of Your unlimited mercy and bless our Noble Master Muhammad to the extent of Your unlimited blessings and send peace upon our Noble Master Muhammad , as much peace that is in Your possession
( (and be kind to our Noble Master Muhammad
) to the extent of Your unlimited kindness.)
12. O Allah, grant our Noble Master Muhammad a suitable reward on our behalf
13. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on the soul of our Noble Master Muhammad among all human souls,
Bestow Your special mercy on the body of our Noble Master Muhammad , among all bodies, bestow Your special mercy on the grave of our Noble Master Muhammad among all the graves
14. Verily, Allah Ta’ala and His angels send durood upon the Messenger . O you who believe, send durood and salaams upon him
13. Al Qawlul Badee Page 12 14. Al Qawlul Badee Page 12

O Allah, my Rabb, I am present and (I am prepared to support Your Deen.) May the mercy of Allah, The Kind and Compassionate, be showered on our Noble Master Muhammad and similarly the greetings of His angels, His chosen ones, the

Messengers, the very pious believers, the martyrs and the righteous people and all things which glorify Allah, be offered to our Noble Master Muhammad the son of Abdullah, the last Nabi and the head of all the Ambiyaa, the leader of the pious, the messenger of the Rabb of the worlds, who will be a witness (on the Day of Judgement). He is the giver of glad tidings, and he invites to You with Your permission and he spreads the light (like an illuminating lamp), so peace be upon him
15. O Allah, accept the intercession of our Noble Master Muhammad which is most weighty, raise him to the highest rank and grant him whatever he has asked for, in this world and in the Hereafter
15. Al Qawlul Badee Page 122 just as You granted it to Ibraahim and Musa
16. O Allah, grant our Noble Master Muhammad the greatest excellence and the highest rank and honour in Your Court from amongst all Your servants and make his intercession the most acceptable to You
O Allah, grant him such followers from amongst his people and children,

16. Al Qawlul Badee Page 122 that it may become a source of coolness to his eyes. Grant him a reward on our behalf which is better than what You have granted to any Nabi on behalf of his followers and grant an excellent reward to all the Ambiyaa and may peace be upon all the Messengers and all praise is due to Allah, the Cherisher of the worlds
17. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master
Muhammad , his family,

17. Al Qawlul Badee Page 122 companions, children, inmates of his house, family, near and distant friends, followers, devotees and include us along with all of them, O Most Merciful and Most Compassionate
18. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad in quantities equal to this world and the world Hereafter. Shower Your blessings on our Noble Master
Muhammad in quantities equal to this world and the
18. Al Qawlul Badee Page 122 world Hereafter and be kind to our Noble Master Muhammad in quantities equivalent to this world and the world
Hereafter. Grant peace to our noble master Muhammad in quantities equal to this world and the world hereafter
19. O Allah, I beg You, O Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful, the Giver of protection to those who seek it, the Comforter

19. Al Qawlul Badee Page 123 of the fear stricken people, The Helper of the helpless, The Support of one who has no support, The Supplier for the one who has no provisions, The Sanctuary of the weak, The Treasure of the poor, The Greatest Source of hope,
The Saviour of the drowned and doomed ones,
The Benefactor, The Beneficent, The Gracious, The Bountiful,
The Almighty, The Overpowering Rabb, The Radiant One before whom the darkness of the night, the brightness of the day, the rays of the sun,
The light of the moon, the rustling of the trees and the humming of the streams all make sajdah
O Allah, You are indeed Allah and You have no partner. I beg of You that You bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master
Muhammad , Your servant and messenger, and upon his family
20. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad and his progeny from the first to the last among human beings and the high-ranking angels, till the Day of Qiyaamah
21. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad and his family as much as You would love and be pleased with
20.Al Qawlul Badee Page 124 21. Al Qawlul Badee Page 125

22. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad and his family, a mercy which pleases You, and fulfils his right towards You and grant him the position of Waseela and Maqaam-e-Mahmood (Special positions in Jannah) which You have promised
And grant him a befitting reward on our behalf, the best of rewards which You have ever granted to any nabi on behalf of his people. And bestow Your special mercy on all
22. Al Qawlul Badee Page 125 his brethren from the Ambiyaa and the righteous servants, O The Most Merciful and most Compassionate

23. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad among the first to come. Bestow Your special mercy on him among the last to come. Bestow Your special mercy on him amongst the prophets. Bestow Your special mercy on him amongst the Messengers
23. Al Qawlul Badee Page 127 and bestow Your special mercy on him, till the Day of Judgement, amongst the high ranking angels

O Allah, continue sending durood upon our Noble Master Muhammad until you are pleased and continue sending blessings upon him even after You are pleased and bless him forever and ever. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad as
You have commanded us to offer salutations to him; send salutations upon him in the manner
You would be pleased that durood is sent upon him. And send salutations upon Nabi Muhammad as much as You desire to be sent upon him

O Allah, grant Your special mercy to our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad equal to the number of Your creation and to the extent of Your pleasure. Send salutations upon Nabi Muhammad equal to the weight of
Your Throne and send salutations equal to the ink used to write
Your words which never end. O Allah, grant our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad the position of Waseela and grant him excellence and a very high rank
O Allah, honour his testimony to prophet-hood (with acceptance), strengthen his testimony and fulfil his wishes regarding his household and his followers
O Allah, shower Your blessings, mercy and kindness on our Noble
Master,
Nabi Muhammad who is Your beloved and chosen one and shower your blessings on the members of his family who are completely purified and pure

O Allah, from all the grace and bounties You have bestowed upon anyone of Your creation, bestow Your best salawaat (salutation) on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad . Bless him and have mercy upon him like that as well. O Allah, shower Your mercy on our Noble Master, , Nabi Muhammad during the night when its darkness covers all things and during the day when it brightens up everything and shower Your mercy upon him in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, bestow Your complete mercy, blessings and peace on our Noble Master,
Nabi Muhammad

O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad who is a guide to goodness, the leader of virtue and a prophet of mercy. O Allah, shower Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad for ever and ever and for all times

O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad the unlettered Arab prophet, who is Quraishi and Haashmi by descent, resident of the Holy City of Makkah, the possessor of the crown (leadership) and the stick (discipline),
( ) one who is blessed with jihad (striving in the path of Allah), spoils of war and the distributor of it

One who imparts virtue and other benefits, has armies under his command, is a generous giver, possess of miraculous signs and special symbols and is predestined to occupy the highest pedestal in the Hereafter. The one who is in charge of the Haudh-e-Kausar (Pond of water) which will be visited by all the (thirsty) people (on the Day of Judgement) and to intercede on behalf of all the creatures by performing sajdah before Allah Ta’ala the Praiseworthy. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad equal to the number of times people have offered their salaams to him as well as the number of those who have not sent salaams upon him. 24. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad who, with his noor, turned darkness into light. O Allah, bless our
Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad who was sent as a
24. Al Qawlul Badee Page 129 mercy for all the people of the worlds
O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad who had been chosen to be the most superior Nabi even before the pen and the plate were created

O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad who was the best in morals and habits. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad who is unique with comprehensive speech and blessed with deep wisdom. O Allah, bless our Noble Master,
Nabi Muhammad in whose presence no one was ever insulted nor was the slightest form of injustice, done by anyone, overlooked
O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi
Muhammad who used to be shaded by a cloud whenever he would travel in any direction

O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad for whom the moon was split into two pieces, stones talked to him and testified to his prophet-hood and supported it. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad who was praised by Allah Ta’ala Himself having been pleased with him since eternity

O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad who has been blessed by our Rabb in His Divine Book and we have been commanded therein to send salaat and salaam upon him. Hence we ask You, O Allah, to be pleased with him and to shower Your special mercy on him, his family, companions and wives for as long as the rains continue to pour and the sails of forgiveness are extended over the sinners and
(O Allah) grant him peace, excellence and honour
25. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad whose noor (light) preceded the entire creation and whose arrival became a mercy unto all the worlds
Let Your special mercy be repeated as many times as the number of Your creatures, past, present and future, as well as the number of fortunate and doomed among them
Rather, a mercy which exceeds all mathematical figures and
25. Al Qawlul Badee Page 130 whose limits know no end
Such salawaat which is everlasting with Your eternal existence and
(O Allah) favour the family and companions of our beloved Nabi with the same amount of mercy
All praise is due to Allah for all of this
26. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi
Muhammad , Your bondsman and messenger, and
26. Al Qawlul Badee Page 269 bestow Your mercy on all the believing men and women and all Muslim men and Muslim women
27. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad and his family
O Allah, bless us with halaal sustenance which is pure and blessed, such that it will save our respect from having to approach
27. Al Qawlul Badee Page 272 any one of Your creation for help
O Allah, make for us an easy path towards You which is not tiresome or painful and has no obligation for us towards others
O Allah, save us from haraam (unlawful) in whichever form, from whichever place or from any person. Please come in between us and those people who have such (haraam) means
Turn away their hands from us and divert their hearts from us, so that we become immune from such things and act only in accordance with Your pleasure. (O Allah) enable us to utilise
Your gifts to do such actions which are pleasing to You, O The Most Merciful of those who show mercy
28. O Allah, I beg of You with a request that is the best in Your sight,
(I beg of You) through Your names which are dearest and most exalted to You,

28. Al Qawlul Badee Page 360 through Your greatest favour upon us, i.e. favouring us with Nabi Muhammad and saving us through him from falling into misguidance. You commanded us to send salawaat upon him and made this practice a means of achieving great heights, an atonement for our sins and attaining Your kindness and mercy. I beg of You, honouring Your command, in compliance with Your order and in fulfilment of the duty which we owe to our Nabi in an attempt to try and fulfil his rights which we owe to him. You have commanded
Your servants that they offer salawaat upon him; an obligation which you have made compulsory on them
I also beg of You by the Majesty of Your countenance and the light of
Your Greatness that You, O Allah, along with Your angels send the best greetings and bestow the best mercy upon our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad , Your servant, prophet, messenger and the chosen one
Verily You are the

Praiseworthy and the Glorious. O Allah, grant him a high rank, an honourable position, make his scales weighty, grant him his reward in abundance, strengthen his testimony, allow his religion to dominate and intensify his light, continue his excellence and nobility through his children and family who may become a source of coolness to his eyes and grant him superiority over all the Ambiyaa (A.S) that preceded him

O Allah, grant superiority to our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad over all other Ambiyaa in as far as the number of his followers and supporters are concerned, in excellence, splendour and rank, grant him the most spacious abodes in paradise, the most amount of reward, the closest to You in Your presence, firmness in position, correctness in speech, success in having his duas answered, the most fortunate in Your Court, the most desirous for what is with You and (O Allah) grant him the highest abode in
Jannah to live therein forever

O Allah, make our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad the most truthful in speech, most successful in his duas, the first to intercede (on the Day of Judgement), the most privileged amongst the intercessors and accept his intercession on behalf of his ummat to the extent which may be enviable to all the Ambiyaa and (O Allah) when You give Your final verdict (on the Day of Judgement), assigning different positions to Your servants, then place our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad in the category of those who are the most truthful in expression, most virtuous in deeds and the best guided as far as treading the path is concerned
O Allah, make Nabi our guide and make his pond (Haudh -e-Kausar) a place for quenching our thirst
O Allah, raise us (on the Day of Judgement) amongst his assembly, enable us to follow his Sunnah, cause us to die adhering to his religion and raise us from amongst his group

O Allah unite us with him as we have believed in him without having seen him and make it such that we may not be separated from him to the extent that we enter into Jannah with him and (O Allah) include us amongst his companions along with the Ambiyaa, the Truthful believers, the martyrs and the righteous. And What a blessed company that will be!
O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi
Muhammad who is the light of guidance, who leads people towards virtue, calls them to righteousness, The Nabi of Mercy,

) ( who soothes all grief, is the head of all the pious and the messenger of the Rabb of the worlds. (O Allah bestow Your special mercy on him) as he conveyed Your message, recited Your aayaat, advised Your servants, established Your law (limits), fulfilled his promises to You, carried out Your commandments, enjoined obedience to You, prohibited Your disobedience, befriend those whom You liked to be befriended, showed enmity towards Your enemy whom You were pleased that they be treated such
May Allah’s blessings be showered on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad

O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on his body among all other bodies, on his soul among all other souls, on his abode among all other abodes, on his position among all other positions and (O Allah) wherever there is mention of his name let it be supplemented by our durood to our Nabi
O Allah, convey our salaams to him whenever there is mention of it and may peace and Allah’s blessings and mercy be upon Nabi
O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on Your chosen angels, all the Ambiyaa and messengers sent by You, on all the carriers of Your Throne, on Jibraeel Mikaeel , Israfeel , the angel of death,

Ridwaan (the angels guarding Jannah), Maalik (the angel guarding Jahannam), on Kiraaman Kaatibeen (the angels who record good and bad deeds) and (O Allah) send Your choicest blessings upon the family of our Nabi’s household compared to the inmates of the households of all the other Messengers and the best reward to the companions of Your
Nabi as compared to all the companions of the other Messengers
O Allah, forgive me and all the believing men and women, all the Muslim men and women including those who are alive and those who have passed away and our Muslim brothers who lived before us, and
(O Allah) do not leave any ill-feelings in our hearts towards the
Muslims. Verily You are Most Kind and all Merciful
29. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi
Muhammad , Your servant, Your messenger,
29. Al Qawlul Badee Page 378
) ( And a Nabi who is unlettered and upon all his family members and companions. Peace be upon them all

30. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad whenever people remember and mention his name and bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad whenever heedless people fail to remember and mention him
31. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi
Muhammad Your servant, messenger and the unlettered nabi, who has believed in You and Your Book and (O Allah), favour him with Your special mercy, elevate him over all
Your creatures (for all time) up to the Day of Judgement and grant Him the best reward
May peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him
32. Your Rabb who is Most Honoured, is unblemished and far above what the unbelievers say (about Him). Peace be upon all the
32. S: Saafaat V: 180-182
Messengers and all praise is due to Allah, the Cherisher of the worlds
61. O Allah, complete for us our noor (light) and forgive us. Verily You have power over all things
62. O Allah, forgive me, my parents, and those Muslims who have entered my house as well as all the believing men and women
In the name of Allah, most Compassionate most Merciful

63. Say: I seek refuge in the Rabb of the daylight, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of the darkness of night when it covers (all things), from the evil of those women who blow into knots and from the evil of the jealous one when his jealousy becomes active
In the name of Allah, the most Compassionate the most Merciful
64. Say: I seek refuge in the Rabb of mankind, the Ruler of mankind, Deity
63. Falaq 64. Naas of mankind, from the evil of the devil who withdraws (when Allah Ta’ala is remembered) whether from among men or Jinn who whisper evil thoughts into the hearts of men

65. O Allah, You are Free from all blemishes. The greeting of the inmates of Jannah will be: Salaam and their final call will be: All praise is due to Allah the Nourisher of the worlds : 66. Allah Ta’ala has declared: And for Allah are beautiful names so call Him by the same : 67. Rasulullah has said:
There are 99 names of Allah. Whoever memories them
( ) will enter into Jannah. (They are as follows)

The guardian The Giver of The Giver of The most holy The King of all things protection peace
The one who The brings The greatest The Creator Overpowering The Mighty creation in to in majesty Rabb being
The Generous Exceedingly Fashioner of The Sustainer Almighty Rabb Giver Forgiving shapes

Knower of Maker of The Tolerant All Aware innermost The just Judgments secrets
The most Highly Most High Forgiving The Great great Appreciative

Most Loving The Wise The Lenient The Answerer The Custodian
The Absolute The true in his The glorious The Guardian The Witness Resurrector of being and and exalted the dead existence
The loving The all The Patron and The Invincible The Almighty knowing Praiseworthy supporter

Free from The depriver The Bestower The Assembler The Just need

Most Forbearing One who guides onto the path of The Supporter of all The Eternal virtue

68. The greatest name (Ism-e-A’zam) of Allah, which when invoked surely leads to the acceptance of dua : and one is granted whatever is asked for, (it is as follows)...... There is no deity besides You
You are free from all blemishes; Indeed I am from the sinners
69. O Allah, I beg of You by saying that I bear witness that verily You are Allah
There is no deity beside You. You are One and totally independent, Who was neither born from anyone nor gave birth to anyone nor is there anyone equal to Him
70. O Allah, I beg of You by saying that all praise is for You. There is no god besides You
) ( You are One, You have no partner. You are Most Kind and Most Compassionate
The Creator of the heavens and the earth. O, You Majestic and Benevolent Rabb, the Everlasting, the Sustainer,
71. O, The Most Merciful of those who show mercy
72. My Rabb is unblemished, Most High and The Most Generous Giver
73. I seek refuge with the perfect words of Allah against the evil of what was created
74. In the name of Allah whose name wards off the harm of all things in the heavens and the earth and He hears and knows every thing
75. Morning has come to us, and the entire kingdom, in a condition that it belongs solely to Allah. All Praise be to Allah

There is no god besides Allah. He is One and without any partner. For Him is the entire Kingdom and praises and He has power over everything. O Allah, I beg of You for all the good which pertains to this day as well as the coming days and I seek Your protection from all evil which pertains to this day as well as the coming days. O Allah, I seek Your protection from laziness and extreme old age. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the punishment of Jahannam and the punishment of the grave

76. O Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, who knows what is concealed and visible, the Rabb and Master of everything. I bear witness that there is no deity besides You and You are One and without any partner
I seek Your protection from the evil of my Nafs (carnal self) and from the evil of Shaytaan and his traps and from committing evil or involving
Another Muslim in evil
77. O Allah, the morning has come to me whilst I make You my witness, and the angels that carry
Your Throne, and all Your remainder angels and Your entire creation witnesses that indeed you are Allah, there is no deity besides You and that Muhammad is Your servant
And your messenger
78. O Allah, I beg of You for aafiyat (safety ease) in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I beg of Your for forgiveness and (aafiyat) safety in my Deen, my dunya, my family, and in my wealth

O Allah, hide my faults and save me from fear and apprehension. O Allah, protect me from in front of me and from behind me, on my right and on my left and above me. I seek protection in Your Grandeur that I may be destroyed by any disaster from beneath me
79. We are pleased with Allah as our Rabb, Islam as our religion and Hadhrat Muhammad as our Rasul and Messenger
80. O Allah, whatever blessings and favours I or any of
Your creation have received this morning is exclusively from You and You have no partner
All praise and gratitude is due to You only
81. O Allah, grant me aafiyat (sound health) in my body, my hearing and my eye-sight. There is no deity besides
) ( You. (Read thrice). O Allah, I seek Your protection from
(kufr) disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek Your protection from being punished
) ( in the grave. There is no deity besides You. (Read this dua thrice)

82. Allah Ta’ala is absolutely pure and all praises are due to Him. There is no power to do good nor to avoid evil except with the help of Allah. Whatever Allah willed has happened and whatever He did not will could not happen
I am convinced that Allah Ta’ala has power over everything and that Allah Ta’ala fully comprehends all things in His knowledge

83. O Allah, The Everlasting The Sustainer, I passionately beg Your mercy. Correct all my affairs for me and do not hand me over to myself even for a blink of an eye : 84. Sayyidul Istighfaar: for istigfaar the most comprehensive dua is the following:
O Allah, You are my Rabb, there is no god besides You. You have created me and I am
Your servant. As far as possible I try to abide by the promises and covenants (which I made to You)
I seek Your protection from the evil of my sins. I fully acknowledge the favours You have bestowed upon me and I confess to my mistakes. Please forgive me as none besides
You can forgive sins
85. O Allah, of all the things that are remembered, You are most rightful to be remembered and of all things that are worshipped

You are the most worthy of being worshipped, of all the agencies from whom help is asked for, You are the Most Helpful. Of all those who are kind, You are the most Kind. Of all those who are looked up to for favours You are the Most Generous. And of all the givers You are the Most well-off. You are the Supreme Ruler and you have no partner. You are unique with no equivalent. All things are to be destroyed except Your Countenance. You cannot be obeyed except with Your permission
You cannot be disobeyed except that it is within Your knowledge. If You are obeyed, it pleases You. If You are disobeyed,

You forgive acts of disobedience. You are the nearest of all those who are present. The closest of protectors, You intervene between the nafs and its evil desires. The hair of the foreheads is in Your hands. You have written down the actions of man (in the Loh-e-

Mahfooz), You have written down the lifespan of man. The (thoughts) of the hearts are known to You and all secrets are disclosed to You. Permissible are only those things which You have specified and likewise prohibition is according to Your commandment. Deen is what You have ordained

The ruling is according to what You have decreed. All creation belongs to You, all slaves belong to You and You are Allah, The Kind, The Merciful. I beg You with the light of Your Countenance, which illuminates the heavens and the earth, and with every right which You only possess and the right which You have allowed unto Your beggars when they beg from You, that You forgive me this morning and evening and that You save me from the fire of Hell with Your power
86. O Allah, I seek Your protection from worry and grief,
I seek Your protection from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness and from being overpowered by debt and the oppression of men
87. O Allah, I am present, I am present and ready to obey You. All good is in

Your hands, it is from You and it all leads towards You. O Allah, whatever word I have uttered, or promise I have made, or vow I have undertaken, it is all subject to Your will. Whatever You willed has happened and whatever You do not intend will never happen. There is no ability to avoid sins nor power to do good except with Your help

You have power over everything. O Allah, if I made dua for anyone, let it benefit that person whom You regard as deserving of it, and if I cursed anyone, let it affect him whom You regard as deserving of it. You are my Guardian in this world and the hereafter
Allow me to die as a Muslim and unite me with the pious

O Allah, I beg of You to make me pleased with Your decisions, (I beg of You) a comfortable life after death, the extreme delight of seeing Your Countenance and a passion for meeting You in a condition where I am not in any difficult position nor any fitnah (trial) that would render me misguided. I seek Your protection from oppressing others or from being oppressed or that I should be unjust to anyone or others be unjust to me or that I should deliberately fall into such an error or sin which You would not forgive. O Allah, Beautify us with the beauty of Imaan and make us among those who are rightly guided themselves, as well as a means of guidance for others. O Allah, The Creator of the heavens and the earth, The Knower of the apparent and the unseen,
Majestic and Caring, I make a promise with You in this worldly life and call upon You to bear witness and You are a sufficient witness that
I bear witness that there is no god besides You alone and You have no partner

All power and praise belong to You. You have power over everything and I bear witness that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger. I bear witness that Your promise is true, meeting You is true, the Hour (of Resurrection) is sure to come without doubt

You will bring alive those who are in their graves. If You entrust me to myself You will surely make me a victim to weakness, sin and faults. I have no reliance on anything except Your Kindness. Forgive my sins as none besides You can do so and accept my repentance as You are Most forgiving, Most Merciful

88. O Allah, I beg of You that I be blessed with perfect Imaan, such Imaan which is accompanied by good manners, a prosperous life (in this world) followed by complete success (in the Hereafter). I beg of
Your mercy, peace and forgiveness and (I beg) for Your pleasure
89. O Allah, I beg of You through Your Noble countenance and Your perfect words for Your protection from the evil of all things which You are in full control of

O Allah, only You can remove debts and only You can pardon sins. O Allah Your army can never be defeated, Your promise can never be broken and the wealth of the wealthy cannot benefit them against Your punishment
You are Pure. All praises are due to You
90. There is no deity besides You. You have no partner. You are so pure
O Allah, I beg You to forgive my sins and I beg of You for Your mercy
O Allah, increase me in knowledge and do not turn my heart away (from You) after having guided it and bless me with Your special mercy. Verily You are the
Generous Giver
91. O Allah, forgive my sins, grant me spaciousness in my home and bless me with barakah (blessings) in my sustenance
92. O Allah, make me from those who repent and make me from those who
91. Amalul Yawmi Wal Laylah Pg. 35 observe cleanliness

93. O Allah, the Rabb of the heavens, the earth and the Great Throne (Arsh), My Rabb and The Rabb of all things, The One who causes trees to grow by the splitting of a seed and a kernel, the Revealer of the Taurat, Bible and The Holy Qur’an, I seek Your protection from the evil of all things which You are in full control of. O Allah, You are the First and nothing preceded You. You are the Last and nothing will come after you
You are Apparent and there is nothing above You. You are
Concealed and nothing is beyond You. Pay out our debts and free us from poverty

94. O Allah, The Rabb of the seven heavens and whatever it has over shadowed, And the Rabb of the earths and whatever it holds, the Rabb of the devils and what ever evil they had spread, be a Protector for me against the evil of all Your creatures if they be unjust or cruel to me. Your protection is indeed strong and Your name is full of blessings

95. O Allah, all praise is for You and You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them. You are the Ruler of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them. All praise is for You

You are the (noor) light of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them. All praise is for You. You are True, Your promise is true and our meeting You is a reality, Your word is true. Paradise is a reality. Hell is a reality and all the Ambiyaa are true. Muhammad , the Messenger of Allah, is true and the Hour (of Resurrection) is a reality. O Allah,
I have submitted before You in obedience. I have believed in You and I have placed my trust in You

I have turned my attention solely towards You. Wherever I have quarrelled (in support of right and justice) it was with Your help. I have turned towards You for judgment. You are our Rabb and to You is our ultimate return. Forgive all my sins, past and future, whether done secretly or openly and those sins where I have surpassed the limit (in sinning) and You know more (what I have done) than I know. You are The First and
The Last. There is no god besides You. There is no power to do good and no strength to refrain from evil except with the help of Allah
96. O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, grant me peace, guide me, grant me sustenance, take care of my needs and elevate me
97. O Allah, I am in desperate need towards You for whatever good You may choose to grant me

98. O Allah, Rabb of Jibraeel , Mikaeel and Israfeel , The Creator of the heavens and the earth, The Knower of the unseen and the visible. Certainly You will judge between Your servants (on the Day of Qiyaamah) in matters where they have differed. (O Allah) in these differences, guide me to the truth, with Your command. Verily You guide whomsoever You wish to the straight path

1. O Allah, guide me along with those whom you have guided, grant me ease along with those whom you have granted ease, support me along with those whom You have supported, grant me barakah (blessings) in what

You have given me, save me from the harm of what You have decreed. Verily You decide and none decides against You. Who ever is under Your protection, cannot be disgraced and who is opposed by You cannot gain dignity. Our Rabb, You are full of blessings and Most High
We beg forgiveness and repent before You and may the blessings of Allah be showered upon Nabi
2. O Allah, forgive me and all the believing men and women, all the Muslim men and women, unite their hearts, correct their mutual affairs and help them against

Your enemy and their enemy. O Allah, let Your curse fall on those Kuffaar (disbelievers) who stop people from treading Your path, deny Your prophets and fight Your Awliyaa (friends). O Allah, create rifts in their ranks, shake their feet and send upon them such a punishment which is not averted from sinners
In the name of Allah, The most Compassionate, The most Merciful

3. O Allah! We seek Your help and we seek forgiveness from You and we seek Your guidance. We believe in You, O Allah, we repent to You and we place our trust in You. We praise You for every kind of favour (bestowed upon us)
We express our thanks to You and we are not ungrateful to You
We stay away from the one who disobeys You. O Allah! You alone do we worship and to You do we perform salaah and make sajdah. It is towards You do we flee and we are quick in doing so
We hope for Your mercy and fear Your severe punishment
Verily, Your severe punishment is sure to overtake the disbelievers
4. O Allah, I seek refuge through Your pleasure from Your displeasure and through Your forgiveness from Your punishment. I seek refuge from Yourself
I am unable to praise You sufficiently. You are as You have praised
Yourself
5. O Allah, The Rabb of Jibraeel , Mikaeel , Israfeel and Muhammad , I seek Your protection from the Fire of Hell

6. O Allah, I seek Your protection from being misled or that I should be misled by others and from slipping or being made to slip by others, from oppressing others or from being oppressed, from acting ignorantly or that anyone behaves ignorantly towards me
7. O Allah, fill Your noor (light) into my heart, my eyes, my ears, to my right, to my left, behind me, in front of me, over me and beneath me
O Allah, bestow Your (Noor) light upon me and infuse it into my muscles, flesh, blood, hair, skin, tongue and soul. Grant it to me profusely and make my entire being into Noor
8. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for us and make easy for us the doors of Your sustenance
9. O Allah, save me from the accursed shaytaan
10. O Allah, grant me excellent character as You alone can guide me to acquire this and remove from me all evil character which You alone can remove
11. O Allah, distance me from my sins like how
You have distanced the east from the west
O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow and hail
Cleanse me of sins in the manner white clothing is cleansed of dirt

12. O Allah, all praise be to You in quantities equal to the heavens and the earth, what is in-between them and whatever is beyond them as You may wish. You alone deserve to be praised, glorified and revered. Whatever Your slave has said is true, and we are all Your slaves
None can prevent what You bestow and none can bestow what You prevent
None can reverse what You have decreed and the wealth of the wealthy in front of You (O Allah) is of no benefit to them
13. O Allah, forgive all my sins, minor and major, the first and the last, and those which I committed openly or secretly
14. O Allah, bless me with taqwa (Your fear) and purify my soul as You are the Best
Purifier. You are the Guardian and Master of my soul
15. O Allah, I have seriously wronged myself and none besides You can forgive sins, so forgive me and have mercy on me. Verily You are Most Forgiving and Most Merciful
16. O Allah, put me through an easy reckoning

17. O Allah, I beg You for all kinds of good, that which I know and that which I do not know. And I seek Your protection from all evil that which I know and that which I do not know. O Allah, I beg of You all the good which was asked for by Your pious servants and I seek Your protection from all kinds of evil which they had sought Your protection from
O Allah, grant us the good of this world, the good of the hereafter and save us from the punishment of Hell

O Allah, we have believed, so forgive our sins and pardon our transgressions and let us die with the righteous. O Allah, grant us whatever You have promised to us through Your Messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Qiyaamah
Verily You never break Your promise
18. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the punishment of Hell, the punishment of the grave, from the mischief of Dajjaal, from the trials of life and death, from sins and from debts
19. O Allah, help me in remembering You, being grateful to You and worshipping You well
20. O Allah, our Rabb and the Rabb of all things, I bear witness that You are the Sole Nourisher, You are One and have no partner
